name: Brick Schema
summary: Brick Schema is an open OWL ontology for modeling buildings, infrastructure, and their systems, including spaces, equipment, power distribution, cooling, HVAC, and sensors. It provides a formal semantic foundation to represent and reason over the physical and infrastructural structure of AI factories and data centers.
